section_summary.extract_value: This section details the statistical analysis methods used, employing IBM SPSS Statistics 21 and the PROCESS macro for SPSS (Hayes, 2013). It describes simple linear regression and bootstrap significance tests with 5000 samples and a 95% bias-corrected and accelerated confidence interval. Out of 118 initial participants, two were excluded due to incomplete measures, resulting in an effective sample size of 116 for the analysis.
